description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role
Fivetran, now combined with dbt Labs, is scaling its reseller channel across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. As the EMEA Resell Partner Development Manager, you will own the growth of our reseller, VAR, and distribution ecosystem across the region, spanning UK&I, DACH, France, Benelux, the Nordics, Southern Europe, and the Middle East and Africa. You will manage and expand relationships with existing resell partners, recruit and onboard new strategic partners, and drive partner-sourced and partner-fulfilled revenue. Your focus will be enablement, joint pipeline generation, and establishing Fivetran as the leading platform for modern data integration and transformation.
We are seeking a highly motivated, experienced channel leader with a proven track record of building and scaling resell and VAR partnerships across multiple EMEA markets, including pan-European solution providers, regional specialists, distributors, cloud marketplaces, and public sector frameworks.

Key qualifications include:
Demonstrated experience in channel sales, reseller programs, and GTM execution within the software or SaaS industry across EMEA
Established relationships with pan-European and regional solution providers (for example SoftwareOne, Softcat, Computacenter, Bechtle, Insight, Atea, Bytes) and familiarity with how their sales organizations, incentives, and procurement processes operate
Experience working with distributors such as Ingram Micro, TD SYNNEX, Arrow, or ALSO, and an understanding of two-tier channel models
Working knowledge of cloud marketplace transactions, including AWS Channel Partner Private Offers (CPPO), Microsoft Azure Multiparty Private Offers, and Google Cloud Marketplace
Understanding of EMEA public sector procurement, including frameworks such as UK G-Cloud and Crown Commercial Service and EU tender processes, is a strong plus
Familiarity with EMEA data regulation and sovereignty considerations, including GDPR, and how they shape customer buying decisions
Deep understanding of the data integration and cloud ecosystem, with the ability to articulate Fivetran’s value proposition
Strong business development and negotiation skills to identify, onboard, and scale strategic reseller relationships
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with regional sales leadership, alliances, marketing, and deal desk across multiple countries and time zones
Self-starter mindset with a passion for building and scaling programs in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German, French, Dutch, or a Nordic language is a strong plus
This is a full-time position based in the United Kingdom or a major EMEA hub [London / remote].

Technologies You’ll Use
 Salesforce, Looker, Gong, Crossbeam

What You’ll Do
Develop and nurture relationships with key EMEA resell and distribution partners, aligned to shared revenue targets and joint business plans
Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, ensuring alignment with Fivetran’s EMEA sub-regional sales teams on joint go-to-market strategy
Build joint business plans with partners that include pipeline goals, incentive programs, enablement milestones, and demand generation campaigns
Drive net-new pipeline through partner sales teams, including targeted programs for the Commercial and Mid-Market segments
Identify and recruit new resell partners aligned to Fivetran’s EMEA target markets, with attention to coverage gaps by country and sub-region
Guide partners through marketplace and private offer transactions in coordination with Deal Desk and Partner Operations
Partner with Partner Enablement and Partner Marketing to take resellers from onboarding to selling, including value proposition, use cases, and quote-to-cash processes
Conduct regular partner trainings, QBRs, and workshops to drive engagement and knowledge retention
Track partner performance, pipeline, and attainment, and provide actionable insights to EMEA and Global Channel leadership
Represent partner capabilities to Fivetran sales teams to drive co-sell alignment and rules of engagement
Achieve or exceed assigned EMEA resell bookings targets

Skills We’re Looking For
Strong relationship-building capabilities with partner executives and field sellers alike, across diverse business cultures
Sales acumen and negotiation skills to manage pricing, margins, and agreement terms that drive mutually beneficial growth
Ability to analyze EMEA market trends by country, segment, and vertical, and craft go-to-market plans for reseller partners
Proficiency in building and delivering partner training programs
Strong analytical skills to track reseller performance, identify improvement areas, and report to senior management
Entrepreneurial spirit and comfort operating in a newly combined organization

Bonus Skills
Experience with cloud data platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery
Familiarity with dbt and the analytics engineering ecosystem
An established network across the EMEA reseller and distribution landscape
The ability to communicate technical concepts to both business and technical stakeholders

 

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.     

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form.
